focus: 敘事時態：過去式、過去進行式、過去完成式、used to

chunks.ex: I didn't know it at the time, but that night changed my career.
All of a sudden, the lights went out.

chunks.zh: 等到…的時候（前面的事已經發生）
chunks.ex: By the time the doctor arrived, I had already cleaned the wound.
It turned out that he had forgotten to take his medicine.
I had never seen a patient so frightened before.
I used to hate night shifts.
I was about to leave when the call bell rang.
The fire alarm went off in the middle of my exam.
As soon as I saw his face, I knew something was wrong.
I met my teacher on my way to the hospital.
At first, I thought he was joking.
In the end, everyone was safe.
Looking back, it was the most useful night of my training.
I handed over to the morning nurse at seven.
Please keep an eye on the patient in Bed 4.
I held his hand until he calmed down.

chunks.en: it was the first time I had …
chunks.ex: It was the first time I had worked a night shift.
I arrived on the ward out of breath.

listen.title: Night handover
listen.scene: 夜班護理師跟早班交班，說昨晚發生的事

dialogue.en: Morning, Sarah. How was the night?
dialogue.zh: 早安，Sarah。昨晚怎麼樣？

dialogue.en: Busy. Mr. Lee in Bed 4 had a fall at about three.
dialogue.zh: 很忙。4 床的李先生大概三點跌倒了。

dialogue.en: Oh no. What happened?
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，怎麼了？

dialogue.en: He was walking to the toilet when he slipped. He hadn't called for help, because he didn't want to wake anyone.
dialogue.zh: 他走去廁所的時候滑倒。他沒有按鈴叫人，因為不想吵醒大家。

dialogue.en: Was he hurt?
dialogue.zh: 他有受傷嗎？

dialogue.en: Just a small cut on his arm. By the time the doctor arrived, I had already cleaned it and checked his blood pressure.
dialogue.zh: 手臂只有一個小傷口。醫師到的時候，我已經清好傷口、量過血壓了。

dialogue.en: Good. Did anything else happen?
dialogue.zh: 很好。還有發生別的事嗎？

dialogue.en: Mrs. Chen couldn't sleep. She used to work nights herself, so she says her body still thinks it's daytime.
dialogue.zh: 陳太太睡不著。她以前自己也上夜班，所以她說她的身體還以為現在是白天。

dialogue.en: Ha, I know that feeling. Anything I need to do this morning?
dialogue.zh: 哈，我懂那種感覺。今天早上有什麼要我做的嗎？

dialogue.en: Please keep an eye on Mr. Lee, and make sure his call bell is within reach.
dialogue.zh: 請多留意李先生，確定他的呼叫鈴伸手就拿得到。

questions.q: What was Mr. Lee doing when he fell?
What had Sarah done before the doctor arrived?
options: Cleaned the cut and checked his blood pressure

questions.q: Why can't Mrs. Chen sleep at night?
options: She used to work night shifts.

heldListen.title: My first injection
heldListen.scene: 兩個護理系同學午餐時聊今天的實習

dialogue.en: You look happy, Jason. What happened?
dialogue.zh: Jason，你看起來很開心。發生什麼事？

dialogue.en: I gave my first real injection today. Well, I helped the nurse give a flu shot.
dialogue.zh: 我今天第一次幫真人打針。嗯，是幫護理師打流感疫苗。

dialogue.en: Were you nervous?
dialogue.zh: 你會緊張嗎？

dialogue.en: Very! My hands were shaking while I was cleaning the patient's arm.
dialogue.zh: 超緊張！我在幫病人消毒手臂的時候手一直在抖。

dialogue.en: Had you practised before?
dialogue.zh: 你之前練習過嗎？

dialogue.en: Only on a plastic arm in the lab. I'd done it maybe twenty times, but a real person is different.
dialogue.zh: 只在實驗室的塑膠手臂上練過。大概打過二十次，但真人就是不一樣。

dialogue.en: How did the patient react?
dialogue.zh: 病人有什麼反應？

dialogue.en: She was really kind. She told me she used to be a nurse, and that her own first injection had gone badly.
dialogue.zh: 她人超好。她說她以前是護理師，而且她自己第一次打針很不順。

dialogue.en: Badly? What happened?
dialogue.zh: 不順？怎麼了？

dialogue.en: She'd dropped the needle on the floor in front of the patient! She said everyone makes mistakes at the start.
dialogue.zh: 她在病人面前把針掉到地上！她說每個人剛開始都會出錯。

dialogue.en: That's sweet. So she made you feel better.
dialogue.zh: 好貼心。所以她讓你比較放鬆了。

dialogue.en: Yeah. By the time I finished, my hands had stopped shaking.
dialogue.zh: 對啊。等我打完的時候，手已經不抖了。

questions.q: What did Jason do today?
options: He had his own flu shot.
He helped give a flu shot.
He taught a class in the lab.

questions.q: When were Jason's hands shaking?
options: While he was cleaning the patient's arm
When he was practising in the lab

questions.q: What do we learn about the patient?
options: She used to work as a nurse.

questions.q: What happened during the patient's own first injection, long ago?
options: She forgot to clean the arm.

speak.title: 交班說故事
speak.zh: 你是夜班護理師，跟早班的 Emma 交班：說昨晚發生的一件事——發生的時候病人正在做什麼、在那之前你已經做了什麼。她會追問細節。
speak.en: Role-play: you are the morning nurse taking a handover from him (he worked the night shift). Ask what happened during the night. Ask follow-up questions that make him use the past continuous (What was the patient doing when it happened?), the past perfect (Had you already checked…? What had happened before that?) and the past simple.

speak.title: 以前和現在
speak.zh: 跟 Emma 聊你以前的習慣和現在有什麼不一樣（used to），再詳細講一個小時候的回憶。
speak.en: Chat about how his life has changed. Ask what he used to do as a child that he does not do now (used to), then ask him to tell one childhood memory in detail. Ask what was happening at the time and what had happened before that moment.

focus: 未來的說法：已經約好的安排（現在進行式）、will be + -ing、will have + 過去分詞

chunks.ex: This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Tokyo.
By the time you arrive, I'll have finished my shift.

chunks.en: by the end of the week
chunks.ex: I'll have read three chapters by the end of the week.
The new nurses are due to start on Monday.
I'm supposed to meet my mentor at seven.
Can you fit in a meeting on Friday?
Could we swap shifts on Sunday?
Dr. Chen is on call tonight.
I need to book an appointment with the dentist.
Please tell us in advance if you can't come.
Please hand in your report by Friday at the latest.
Let the office know as soon as possible.
I'm looking forward to meeting you.
Set aside fifteen minutes a day for review.
Start from the exam date and work backwards.
The clinic is running behind this morning.
We're on track to finish the course by June.
We need to get through ten patients before lunch.

dialogue.en: Hey Mia, are you working on Saturday?
dialogue.zh: 嘿 Mia，你星期六有上班嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes, I'm doing the early shift. Why?
dialogue.zh: 有，我上早班。怎麼了？

dialogue.en: My sister's getting married on Sunday, and I'm rostered on the night shift. Could you swap with me? I'll do your Saturday early shift.
dialogue.zh: 我姊姊星期天結婚，可是我被排了大夜。你可以跟我換嗎？我幫你上星期六的早班。

dialogue.en: Sunday night... What time does it start?
dialogue.zh: 星期天晚上……幾點開始？

dialogue.en: Eleven. I'll be working from eleven till seven in the morning, so you'd be doing the same.
dialogue.zh: 十一點。我會從晚上十一點上到早上七點，所以你也是一樣。

dialogue.en: On Sunday afternoon I'm meeting my study group, but I'll have finished by five. So yes, that works.
dialogue.zh: 星期天下午我約了讀書會，不過五點前就會結束。所以可以，沒問題。

dialogue.en: Thanks! I owe you one. I'll tell the charge nurse today.
dialogue.zh: 謝啦！欠你一次。我今天就去跟組長說。

dialogue.en: No worries. Just remember, this time next week I'll be sitting my exam, so don't ask me again then!
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。只是記得，下週的這個時候我在考試，到時候別再找我換班喔！

dialogue.en: Deal. Good luck with it.
dialogue.zh: 一言為定。考試加油。

questions.q: Why does Jack want to swap shifts?
options: He is going to his sister's wedding.
He is meeting his study group.

questions.q: What will Mia be doing on Sunday afternoon?
What will Mia be doing this time next week?

heldListen.title: Booking a follow-up
heldListen.scene: 病人打電話到診所預約回診

dialogue.en: Good morning, Riverside Clinic. How can I help?
dialogue.zh: 早安，河畔診所，請問需要什麼服務？

dialogue.en: Hello, I need to book a follow-up appointment with Dr. Patel. She wants to see me in two weeks.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我要預約 Patel 醫師的回診。她要我兩週後回來。

dialogue.en: Let me have a look. Dr. Patel will be working on Tuesday the fourteenth. Would ten o'clock suit you?
dialogue.zh: 我看一下。Patel 醫師十四號星期二有看診，十點可以嗎？

dialogue.en: I'm afraid I'll be travelling for work that morning. Is there anything in the afternoon?
dialogue.zh: 那天早上我恐怕在出差。下午有時段嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes, there's a slot at half past three.
dialogue.zh: 有，三點半有一個空檔。

dialogue.en: That's perfect. Do I need to do anything before I come?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。來之前我需要做什麼嗎？

dialogue.en: The doctor will want your blood test results, so please have the test done at least three days before. By then, the lab will have sent the results to her.
dialogue.zh: 醫師會要看你的抽血報告，所以請至少提前三天去抽血。到那時候，檢驗室就會把結果送給她了。

dialogue.en: Right. I'll go to the lab on Friday, then.
dialogue.zh: 好，那我星期五去抽血。

dialogue.en: Lovely. And please bring the list of medicines you're taking.
dialogue.zh: 好的。也請帶你現在吃的藥的清單。

dialogue.en: Will do. Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 好，謝謝。

questions.q: Why can't the patient come at ten o'clock?
options: He will be travelling for work.
He has a blood test then.

questions.q: What time is the appointment?
Why should the patient have the blood test at least three days before?
options: So that the doctor will have the results in time
Because the lab is closed on Fridays
Because he must not eat for three days

questions.q: What does the receptionist ask him to bring?

speak.title: 商量換班
speak.zh: 你想跟 Emma 換班：說出你已經約好的事（現在進行式）、那個時間你會在做什麼（will be + -ing）、幾點以前會做完（will have + 過去分詞）。說清楚她才會答應。
speak.en: Role-play: you are his coworker. He wants to swap a shift with you. Ask what he is doing that day, what he will be doing at certain times, and when he will have finished. Make him use the present continuous for arrangements, will be + -ing and will have + past participle. Agree only after he explains clearly.

speak.title: 五年後的我
speak.zh: 跟 Emma 聊五年後：那時候你會在做什麼、住在哪裡，到那時你已經完成了哪些事，為什麼。
speak.en: Chat about his future. Ask what he will be doing in five years, where he will be living, what he will have achieved by then, and why. Ask follow-up questions such as "What will you have learned by then?" and "What will you be doing on a normal Monday?"

focus: 推測：must／might／can't be（現在）、must／might／can't have + 過去分詞（過去）

chunks.ex: Judging by his face, he must be in pain.
There's no way he walked home with that injury.
It looks as if someone has been here.
I bet he forgot his keys again.
I doubt she has eaten anything today.
Don't jump to conclusions before you check the chart.
The doctor wants to rule out an infection.
All the clues point to dehydration.
A fever can be a sign of infection.
We don't know for sure what happened.
In that case, he can't have left the building.
We came to the conclusion that the machine was broken.
His story doesn't make sense.
Keep track of how much water he drinks.
My phone turned up in my jacket pocket.
Now that you mention it, he did look pale.
Patients who don't drink enough are likely to feel confused.
No wonder he's tired. He worked a twelve-hour shift.

listen.title: Where is my phone?
listen.scene: 室友幫忙推測手機掉在哪裡

dialogue.en: Lisa, have you seen my phone? I can't find it anywhere.
dialogue.zh: Lisa，你有看到我的手機嗎？我到處都找不到。

dialogue.en: When did you last use it?
dialogue.zh: 你最後一次用是什麼時候？

dialogue.en: On the bus this morning. I was texting my mom.
dialogue.zh: 今天早上在公車上，我在傳訊息給我媽。

dialogue.en: Then you must have had it when you got off the bus.
dialogue.zh: 那你下公車的時候一定還帶著。

dialogue.en: I think so. I remember paying for coffee with it at the café.
dialogue.zh: 應該是。我記得在咖啡店用它付了咖啡錢。

dialogue.en: So it can't be on the bus. You might have left it at the café.
dialogue.zh: 所以不可能在公車上。你可能把它留在咖啡店了。

dialogue.en: Maybe. But I also went to the library after that.
dialogue.zh: 有可能。不過之後我還去了圖書館。

dialogue.en: Did you take your jacket off at the library?
dialogue.zh: 你在圖書館有把外套脫下來嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes, I did... and my phone was in the jacket pocket!
dialogue.zh: 有……而且手機就放在外套口袋裡！

dialogue.en: Then it must be in your jacket. Where's your jacket?
dialogue.zh: 那它一定在你的外套裡。你的外套呢？

dialogue.en: Oh no. I must have left the jacket at the library.
dialogue.zh: 完了，我一定是把外套忘在圖書館了。

questions.q: What was the last thing Kevin used his phone for?
Why does Lisa say the phone can't be on the bus?
options: Because he used it at the café after the bus
Because the bus driver called him
Because he never takes the bus

questions.q: Where does Kevin think the phone is in the end?
options: In his jacket at the library

heldListen.title: A patient who will not eat
heldListen.scene: 兩位護理師討論一位不吃飯的病人

dialogue.en: Emily, Mr. Nguyen hasn't touched his lunch again.
dialogue.zh: Emily，阮先生的午餐又一口都沒動。

dialogue.en: That's the third meal in a row. He must be feeling unwell.
dialogue.zh: 這已經連續第三餐了。他一定是不舒服。

dialogue.en: His temperature's normal, though, and he says he isn't in pain.
dialogue.zh: 可是他體溫正常，他也說不會痛。

dialogue.en: Hmm. Did you notice how he was holding his face this morning? He might have a problem with his teeth.
dialogue.zh: 嗯……你有注意到他今天早上一直扶著臉嗎？他的牙齒可能有問題。

dialogue.en: Now that you mention it, his wife said his new false teeth were hurting him.
dialogue.zh: 你這麼一說，他太太說他的新假牙會痛。

dialogue.en: That could be it. He can't have eaten properly if his teeth hurt.
dialogue.zh: 可能就是這個。牙齒會痛的話，他不可能好好吃飯。

dialogue.en: But he drank all his soup yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 可是他昨天把湯全部喝完了。

dialogue.en: Exactly. Soup is soft. So he isn't refusing food in general. He just can't chew.
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。湯是軟的。所以他不是什麼都不吃，他只是沒辦法咀嚼。

dialogue.en: I'll ask the dietitian about softer meals and let the doctor know about his teeth.
dialogue.zh: 我去問營養師能不能改軟一點的餐，也會跟醫師說他牙齒的事。

dialogue.en: Good idea. And check his mouth when you do the afternoon round.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。下午巡房的時候也檢查一下他的口腔。

questions.q: How many meals in a row has Mr. Nguyen not eaten?
What is Emily's first guess?
options: He must have eaten before lunch.

questions.q: What did Mr. Nguyen's wife say?
options: His new false teeth were hurting him.
He never eats lunch at home.
He had a fever at night.

questions.q: Why is the soup an important clue?
options: It shows he can eat soft food but can't chew.
It shows he is not hungry.
It shows he likes hot food.

speak.title: 找線索推理
speak.zh: Emma 一個一個給你線索（例如：病床空了、拖鞋不見、廁所燈亮著），你用 must／might／can't (have) 推測發生了什麼，並說是根據哪個線索。
speak.en: Give him a short mystery with three or four clues, one at a time (for example: a patient's bed is empty, his slippers are gone, the bathroom light is on, his breakfast is untouched). After each clue, ask what he thinks must, might or can't be true now, and what must, might or can't have happened (must/might/can't have + past participle). Ask which clue supports each guess.

speak.title: 猜猜他是誰
speak.zh: Emma 描述一個人的樣子和手上的東西，你推測他是做什麼的、剛剛去過哪裡、接下來要去做什麼；再換你描述、她來猜。
speak.en: Play a guessing game. Describe a person you can "see" (clothes, what they carry, how they look), for example a tired woman in a white coat holding a coffee at 7 a.m. Ask him to guess their job, what they must have just done, and what they might be doing next. Then swap: he describes someone and you guess, using must/might/can't.

focus: 第三類假設：If + had + 過去分詞，would／could／might have + 過去分詞

chunks.ex: If I had known, I would have called you.
I would have helped you if you had asked.
We could have finished earlier.
He might have been seriously hurt.
Why did you go there in the first place?
She noticed the mistake just in time.
Giving insulin to the wrong patient was a near miss.
He was afraid he would get into trouble.
I learned the hard way to save my work.
It's a good thing you brought a first-aid kit.
We ended up walking home in the rain.
Tiredness can lead to mistakes.
As a result, the hospital changed its rules.
Check the wristband; otherwise, you may give the wrong medicine.
One small check made a big difference.
Never take shortcuts with patient safety.
Back up your work every day.
If the bus had come on time, I wouldn't have been late.

listen.title: Stuck on the mountain
listen.scene: 朋友聊上週末爬山遇到大雨

dialogue.en: Ben! I heard you got stuck on the mountain last weekend. Are you OK?
dialogue.zh: Ben！聽說你上週末困在山上，你還好嗎？

dialogue.en: I'm fine now, but it was scary. The weather changed really quickly.
dialogue.zh: 現在沒事了，可是那時候很可怕。天氣變得超快。

dialogue.en: Didn't you check the forecast?
dialogue.zh: 你沒看天氣預報嗎？

dialogue.en: No. If I'd checked it, I wouldn't have gone at all. It said heavy rain all afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 沒有。如果我有看，根本就不會去了。預報說整個下午都是大雨。

dialogue.en: What happened?
dialogue.zh: 後來怎麼了？

dialogue.en: We were halfway up when it started pouring. The path turned to mud, and my friend slipped and hurt his ankle.
dialogue.zh: 我們爬到一半就開始下大雨。步道變成爛泥，我朋友滑倒扭傷了腳踝。

dialogue.en: Oh no. How did you get down?
dialogue.zh: 天啊。那你們怎麼下山？

dialogue.en: Luckily, I'd packed a first-aid kit, so I strapped his ankle. If I hadn't brought it, we couldn't have walked down.
dialogue.zh: 還好我有帶急救包，就幫他把腳踝固定好。如果我沒帶，我們不可能走下山。

dialogue.en: Good thing you had it.
dialogue.zh: 還好你有帶。

dialogue.en: Yes. And if we'd started earlier in the morning, we would have been back before the rain.
dialogue.zh: 對啊。而且如果我們早上早點出發，就會在下雨前回來了。

questions.q: What would Ben have done if he had checked the forecast?
What happened to Ben's friend?
options: He slipped and hurt his ankle.

questions.q: How were they able to walk down?
options: Ben had packed a first-aid kit.

heldListen.title: Missing the deadline
heldListen.scene: 學生跟老師解釋為什麼報告遲交

dialogue.en: Chloe, your case study was due on Friday. What happened?
dialogue.zh: Chloe，你的個案報告星期五就要交了。發生什麼事？

dialogue.en: I'm really sorry. My laptop stopped working on Thursday night, and I lost most of my work.
dialogue.zh: 真的很抱歉。我的筆電星期四晚上壞掉，大部分內容都不見了。

dialogue.en: Hadn't you saved a copy anywhere?
dialogue.zh: 你沒有把檔案另外存一份嗎？

dialogue.en: No. If I'd saved it online, I wouldn't have lost anything.
dialogue.zh: 沒有。如果我有存在雲端，就什麼都不會不見了。

dialogue.en: That's a hard lesson. Why didn't you email me on Thursday?
dialogue.zh: 這是個慘痛的教訓。那你星期四為什麼沒寄信給我？

dialogue.en: I was too embarrassed. But if I'd told you then, you might have given me more time.
dialogue.zh: 我太不好意思了。可是如果我那時候就跟你說，你可能會多給我一些時間。

dialogue.en: Probably, yes. I can give you until Wednesday, but please back up your work this time.
dialogue.zh: 應該會。我可以讓你延到星期三，不過這次請記得備份。

dialogue.en: I will. I've already set up automatic backups.
dialogue.zh: 我會的。我已經設定好自動備份了。

dialogue.en: Good. And next time, tell me early. Problems are much easier to fix that way.
dialogue.zh: 很好。下次早點告訴我，這樣問題比較好解決。

questions.q: When was the case study due?
Why did Chloe lose her work?
options: Her laptop stopped working and she had no copy.

questions.q: Why didn't Chloe email the teacher on Thursday?
options: She didn't have his email address.

questions.q: What is the new deadline?

speak.title: 差點出錯的事
speak.zh: 跟 Emma 說一次差點出錯的事（實習、打工或生活中都可以），再用 If I had…, I would have… 說當時如果怎麼做，結果就會不一樣。
speak.en: Ask him to tell you about a time something almost went wrong (at school, at work, on a placement or at home). Ask what happened, then ask "What would have happened if…?" and "What could you have done differently?" so that he uses If + had + past participle and would/could/might have + past participle.

speak.title: 如果當初沒發生
speak.zh: 跟 Emma 聊：如果某件事當初沒發生（例如盤尼西林沒被發現、你當初沒選護理系），結果會有什麼不同？說兩三個後果和理由。
speak.en: Chat about "what if" in the past. Choose one event together, for example "if penicillin hadn't been discovered" or "if he hadn't chosen nursing". Ask him how things would have been different, and push him to give two or three consequences with reasons, using the third conditional.

focus: 願望和遺憾：wish／if only + 過去式（現在）、wish／if only + had + 過去分詞（過去）、should／shouldn't have + 過去分詞

chunks.ex: I wish I could stay longer.

chunks.en: I wish I had + 過去分詞
chunks.ex: I wish I had studied harder.
If only I had known earlier!
I should have asked for help.
I shouldn't have stayed up so late.
It's no use worrying about it now.
Good nurses learn from their mistakes.
When I look back on my first year, I laugh.
Take care of yourself on night shifts.
Ask for a hand when you move a patient.
Can you cover for me during lunch?
I missed the chance to study abroad.
I want to make up for lost time.
It's not too late to change your major.
I wish I had kept in touch with my classmates.
Don't be too hard on yourself.
It's worth asking a senior nurse.
Don't choose a job only for the sake of money.

listen.title: After a long shift
listen.scene: 兩位護理師下班後聊天

dialogue.en: I'm exhausted. I wish this shift had been shorter.
dialogue.zh: 我累死了。真希望這個班短一點。

dialogue.en: Me too. And I wish I hadn't skipped lunch. I'm starving.
dialogue.zh: 我也是。而且真希望我沒跳過午餐，我快餓死了。

dialogue.en: Why did you skip it?
dialogue.zh: 你為什麼沒吃？

dialogue.en: Two admissions came in at once. I should have eaten something at the break, but I didn't have time.
dialogue.zh: 同時來了兩個新住院的病人。我應該在休息時間吃點東西，可是根本沒時間。

dialogue.en: You should have asked me to cover for you. I had a quiet hour after two.
dialogue.zh: 你應該叫我幫你頂一下的。我兩點以後有一個小時很閒。

dialogue.en: If only I'd known! Anyway, what are you doing tonight?
dialogue.zh: 早知道就好了！對了，你今晚要做什麼？

dialogue.en: Nothing much. I wish I could go to the beach, but I've got an exam on Friday.
dialogue.zh: 沒什麼。真希望能去海邊，可是我星期五有考試。

dialogue.en: What exam?
dialogue.zh: 什麼考試？

dialogue.en: IELTS. I really wish my writing were better.
dialogue.zh: 雅思。我真的希望我的寫作好一點。

dialogue.en: You'll be fine. You've been practising every day.
dialogue.zh: 你沒問題的，你每天都在練。

questions.q: Why did Liam skip lunch?
options: Two admissions came in at once.
He forgot his lunch at home.

questions.q: What does Ruby say Liam should have done?
options: Asked her to cover for him

questions.q: Why can't Ruby go to the beach tonight?
options: She has an exam on Friday.

heldListen.title: Asking Grandpa about regrets
heldListen.scene: 孫子為了作業訪問爺爺有什麼遺憾

dialogue.en: Grandpa, can I ask you something for my class? Do you have any regrets?
dialogue.zh: 爺爺，我可以為了上課的作業問你一個問題嗎？你有什麼遺憾嗎？

dialogue.en: Ha! A few. I wish I'd learned to swim when I was young. I still can't swim.
dialogue.zh: 哈！有幾個。真希望我年輕時有學游泳，我到現在還不會。

dialogue.en: Really? Why didn't you learn?
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？你為什麼沒學？

dialogue.en: We lived far from the sea, and I was always working on the farm. If only there'd been a pool in our town.
dialogue.zh: 我們住得離海很遠，我又一直在農場幫忙。要是我們鎮上有游泳池就好了。

dialogue.en: Anything else?
dialogue.zh: 還有別的嗎？

dialogue.en: I should have gone to see my brother more often. He lived in Japan for many years, and I only visited him twice.
dialogue.zh: 我應該多去看我哥哥的。他在日本住了很多年，我只去看過他兩次。

dialogue.en: That's sad. Do you wish anything about now?
dialogue.zh: 好可惜。那你對現在有什麼希望嗎？

dialogue.en: I wish my knees were stronger! And I wish you lived closer, so you could visit every week.
dialogue.zh: 我希望我的膝蓋強壯一點！也希望你住近一點，這樣你就能每個禮拜來看我。

dialogue.en: I'll come more often, I promise. What advice would you give me?
dialogue.zh: 我會常來的，我保證。你會給我什麼建議？

dialogue.en: Don't wait for the perfect time. Call the people you love, and learn to swim!
dialogue.zh: 不要等完美的時機。打電話給你愛的人，還有，去學游泳！

questions.q: Why is Daniel asking his grandfather questions?
options: Because he is writing a book

questions.q: Why didn't Grandpa learn to swim?
options: He lived far from the sea and worked on the farm.

questions.q: What does Grandpa regret about his brother?
options: He didn't visit him often enough.
He didn't help him move to Japan.

questions.q: What does Grandpa wish about now?
options: That he still worked on the farm

speak.title: 下班後聊遺憾
speak.zh: 下班後跟 Emma 聊：今天有什麼希望不一樣的（I wish…）、有什麼當初應該做或不該做的（should have／shouldn't have）。她也會說她的。
speak.en: You both just finished a long shift. Chat about the day. Ask what he wishes had been different today and what he should or shouldn't have done. Share your own small regrets too, so it feels like a real chat. Encourage wish + past perfect, wish + past simple for now, and should have + past participle.

speak.title: 給學弟妹的建議
speak.zh: Emma 演一個緊張的大一新生向你請教：你用自己的經驗說「我當初應該…／真希望我那時候…」，再給她建議。
speak.en: Role-play: you are a nervous first-year nursing student. Ask him for advice. Ask what he wishes he had known in his first year and what he should have done differently. Then ask what you should do now.

focus: 非限定關係子句：加逗號的 who／which／whose／where 補充說明（不能用 that）

chunks.ex: My aunt, who lives in Hualien, is a midwife.
The new ward, which opened last year, has thirty beds.
Mrs. Lin, whose daughter is a doctor, asks a lot of questions.
We went to Tainan, where my grandparents live.
He forgot his ID card, which caused a long delay.
The volunteers, most of whom are retired, speak English.
I have three exams, all of which are next week.
She gave me some notes, some of which were very useful.
Nightingale was known as the Lady with the Lamp.
The score was named after Dr. Apgar.
Mr. Kao is in charge of the ward today.
Let me show you around the ward.

chunks.en: at the end of the hall
chunks.ex: The staff room is at the end of the hall.
The family room is next to the children's ward.
The emergency department is open 24 hours a day.
She went on to become a famous doctor.
She was a statistician as well as a nurse.
Nurses play an important role in patient safety.

listen.title: Showing a new student around
listen.scene: 護理師帶新來的實習生認識病房

dialogue.en: Welcome to Ward 6, Eric. Let me show you around.
dialogue.zh: Eric，歡迎來到 6 病房。我帶你繞一圈。

dialogue.en: Thanks. It's bigger than I expected.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。比我想的還大。

dialogue.en: This is the nurses' station, where we do handover every morning at seven.
dialogue.zh: 這裡是護理站，我們每天早上七點在這裡交班。

dialogue.en: And who's that?
dialogue.zh: 那位是誰？

dialogue.en: That's Mr. Kao, who's our charge nurse today. He's very kind, so ask him anything.
dialogue.zh: 那是高先生，他是今天的組長。他人很好，有什麼都可以問他。

dialogue.en: OK. What's this room?
dialogue.zh: 好。這間是什麼？

dialogue.en: That's the treatment room, which we keep locked. You'll need a code to get in.
dialogue.zh: 那是治療室，我們都會鎖起來。你要有密碼才能進去。

dialogue.en: Got it. And the patient in Room 3?
dialogue.zh: 了解。那 3 號房的病人呢？

dialogue.en: That's Mrs. Lin, whose daughter is a doctor here. She'll probably ask you lots of questions!
dialogue.zh: 那是林太太，她女兒是這裡的醫師。她大概會問你很多問題！

dialogue.en: Good to know. Where can I leave my bag?
dialogue.zh: 好，先知道一下。我的包包可以放哪裡？

dialogue.en: In the staff room, which is at the end of the hall, next to the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 放員工休息室，在走廊盡頭，茶水間旁邊。

questions.q: When does handover happen?
What do we learn about the treatment room?
options: It is next to the kitchen.

questions.q: Who is Mrs. Lin's daughter?

heldListen.title: An old family photo
heldListen.scene: 朋友一起看一張老照片

dialogue.en: Is that an old photo of your family?
dialogue.zh: 那是你家人的老照片嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes. That's my grandmother, who was a nurse in the 1960s.
dialogue.zh: 對。那是我奶奶，她 1960 年代是護理師。

dialogue.en: Where was this taken?
dialogue.zh: 這是在哪裡拍的？

dialogue.en: Outside the hospital in Leeds, where she trained. It's not there any more. It was knocked down years ago.
dialogue.zh: 在里茲那間醫院外面，她在那裡受訓。現在已經沒有了，好幾年前就拆掉了。

dialogue.en: And the man next to her?
dialogue.zh: 那她旁邊的男士呢？

dialogue.en: That's Dr. Hughes, whose son later married my grandmother. So he's my great-grandfather!
dialogue.zh: 那是 Hughes 醫師，他的兒子後來娶了我奶奶。所以他是我的曾祖父！

dialogue.en: No way! So she met your grandfather through his dad?
dialogue.zh: 不會吧！所以她是透過他爸爸認識你爺爺的？

dialogue.en: Exactly. She was working on Dr. Hughes's ward, which was the children's ward at the time.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。她那時在 Hughes 醫師的病房工作，就是當時的兒科病房。

dialogue.en: That's a lovely story. Is she still alive?
dialogue.zh: 好溫馨的故事。她還在嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes, she's ninety-one, and she still remembers the names of every child she looked after.
dialogue.zh: 還在，她九十一歲了，還記得她照顧過的每個小孩的名字。

questions.q: Who is the woman in the photo?
What happened to the hospital in Leeds?
Who is Dr. Hughes to Sophie?
Which ward did Sophie's grandmother work on?

speak.title: 帶新同學參觀
speak.zh: 你帶新來的 Emma 參觀你的學校或病房：用加逗號的 who／which／whose／where 補充介紹每個地方和人。
speak.en: Role-play: you are a new student and he is showing you around his school or ward. Ask about each place and person you "see" ("What's that room?", "Who's that?"). Encourage him to add extra information with non-defining clauses (who, which, whose, where), for example "This is the skills lab, where we practise injections."

speak.title: 介紹一位你欣賞的人
speak.zh: 跟 Emma 介紹一位你欣賞的人（家人、老師或像南丁格爾這樣的歷史人物）：把背景資訊用補充說明放進同一句。
speak.en: Ask him to tell you about a person he admires (a family member, a teacher, or a historical figure such as Florence Nightingale). Ask follow-up questions about where they lived, what they did and why he admires them. Encourage him to combine information into one sentence with who, which, whose or where.
